items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: We'd go to St. Julien and (?) and (?) if I have to name them...

ctx.x: We toured by helicopter and everything else. Due to the War... We had bauxite mines all the way down to South America, and we had bases naturally down there. We stayed up at Guantanamo. Guantanamo is in Cuba, and that was our headquarters. We'd go to St. Julien and (?) and (?) if I have to name them... But one was at Atkinson Field in British Guyana; it was not Guyana, it was British Guyana. And then Zeinweg(?) Field was in Dutch Guyana. And that's about as far I went. We didn't go to the Cape of Good Hope.

And Zeinweg(?) Field was... Well, the ...(?). ... was the ...(?). ... And that was the jump-off place for the invasion of the American troops into Iran. General Patch(?) was the commanding General in the Caribbean theatre of war. Under his command...
